_comment: Copy to scripts/mainnet-listings.json and fill in. Each stock needs a Chainlink-style USD price feed on Base (feed address + heartbeat in seconds, from the feed's documentation) and the fee tier of a USDC/<stock> Uniswap V3 pool with real liquidity (500, 3000 or 10000). scripts/deploy.mjs --network base --dry-run verifies every feed answers, prices within 5% of Coinbase NAV, and every pool exists with liquidity before anything is deployed. Symbols are Coinbase tokenized-stock symbols.
